His productions include some of the most important and enduring club tracks ever put to wax. But beyond the hits, Dope's discography overflows with gems, across innumerable aliases and collaborations. Dee Diggs has emerged as one of the most vital voices in modern house music. Paying homage to a lineage of Black innovators while forging her own path, Diggs has infused the genre with new life.

description:
St. Gloria  presents The Dollhouse a fantasy of femininity, It belongs to those  who take up space, who understand the art of an entrance, who turn getting dressed into a ritual and a bedroom into a dressing room.  It’s a theatrical presentation, of the characters we become.

For Salon No. 03, St. Gloria brings this world to life through the sounds and styles of mod culture, Motown soul, and unapologetic femininity . Beneath the beehives, the vintage silhouettes, and the domestic daydream is a tribute to the women who give themselves over to their craft.

Our stars, Amber Lara  and Izzy Durso, each bring a world of their own into the room. Their voices, their instruments, and the years behind their artistry are the real heart of this edition. The glamour may draw you in, but the music is what makes you stay.

Because the doll is also the designer. The muse is also the musician. The woman in front of the mirror is the one who decides what happens next.

description:
ØTTA takes over The Roof, bringing her mix of Brazilian trance, techno, psytrance, hard house, and UK garage influences to New York.

The Brazilian artist first gained wider attention through releases including the Plus One EP and Candy22, pairing old school psytrance with Brazilian drums, rolling basslines, bright melodies, and unexpected vocals. Her first Boiler Room performance marked a major point in her rise, introducing audiences around the world to a set style that moves freely between faster club sounds.

In 2024, she released the four track In My 2024 Era EP and launched Hotties, her own record label and event series. The platform has since grown into an outlet for new music and parties featuring artists from across the international club circuit. She followed in 2025 with “Mão Na Parede,” released through Boys Noize’s One To Zero project.

Her 2026 schedule has included Awakenings, Love Family Park, WECANDANCE, Audioriver, Lovefest, Boothstock, RSO.BERLIN, Hï Ibiza, and Brunch Electronik Lisboa. She also returned to New York for Boiler Room beneath the K Bridge.

Now developing a new album while spending time in Rio de Janeiro, ØTTA arrives at Chocolate Factory with new music taking shape and another full year of international shows behind her.
